== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace)]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Icons row, read off each face: only the 2013 slip prints an icon (a yellow [[Pilot]] icon at the right of the game-text box); the printed card (JP-L-artoo-hires.webp) and the later images have none. The Decipher Errata entry is text only.
